guia.texto:
======================================================================
                  OPENSTROKE COMMAND GUIDE
======================================================================

1. PROGRAMS & FILES (Default)
Type executable name or native file path.
• notepad
• calc
• chrome.exe https://google.es
• C:\Windows\System32

2. KEYBOARD SHORTCUTS (Prefix "teclas:")
Simulates physical key combination press on system.
• teclas:ctrl,c            (Copy)
• teclas:ctrl,v            (Paste)
• teclas:shift,win,left    (Move window to left monitor)
• teclas:f5                (Refresh page)

    [ SPECIAL KEYS AVAILABLE ]
    • Modifiers:    win, windows, ctrl, shift, alt
    • Function:     f1, f2, f3, f4, f5, f6, f7, f8, f9, f10, f11, f12
    • System:       enter, space, tab, esc
    • Directional:  up, down, left, right

3. NATIVE WINDOWS (Prefix "ventana:")
Manipulate desktop environment and active foreground window.
• ventana:minimizar        (Minimizes active window and saves to memory)
• ventana:maximizar        (Maximizes or restores active window)
• ventana:restaurar_una    (Rescues last window minimized by OpenStroke)
• ventana:cerrar           (Closes active window - Alt+F4)
• ventana:fijar            (Pins window Always on Top)
• ventana:transparente     (Applies 50% ghost transparency)
• ventana:siguiente        (Fast jump to next window)
• ventana:atras            (Reverse jump to previous window)
• ventana:arriba           (Up one folder level / Backspace)
• ventana:minimizar_todas  (Hides entire workspace)
• ventana:restaurar_todas  (Restores all minimized windows)
• ventana:escritorio       (Shows or hides desktop - Toggle)

[ ADVANCED COMMAND GUIDE ]

1. MACROS (Prefix "macro:")
Chains multiple actions separated by "|". 
Example: macro:https://gmail.com | esperar:2.0 | teclas:ctrl,t
• esperar:X.X   (Pause in seconds)
• teclas:X,Y    (Keyboard combinations)

2. WINDOW MANAGEMENT (System shortcuts)
You can use prefix "teclas:" to move windows between monitors:
• Move left:   teclas:win,shift,left
• Move right:  teclas:win,shift,right
• Maximize:    teclas:win,up
• Minimize:    teclas:win,down

======================================================================
